description: This file defines an internal interface ISystemTargetBase within the Orleans namespace, used to support system target functionalities such as generating grain references and retrieving activation addresses.

classes.name: ISystemTargetBase
classes.description: An internal interface for system targets, extending IGrainContext, with a property to get the Silo address where the target is activated.

methods.name: Silo
methods.description: A property that returns the SiloAddress indicating where the system target is activated.
